newsitem.title: ITALY: Five ex-Gemina employees being arrested.
newsitem.headline: Five ex-Gemina employees being arrested.

text.p: Italian finance police are in the process of arresting five former employees of the financial holding group Gemina on Wednesday on the orders of magistrates Francesco Greco and Carlo Nocerino on charges of false accounting, a police spokesman said.

Emil Schneeberg, an ex-manager of the company, has already been arrested on charges of false accounting, while two other employees are being sought, and two further employees are believe to be abroad, the police spokesman said.
Gemina's financial affairs have been the subject of scrutiny after an investigation into alleged fraudulent book-keeping was opened late last year into the company and its RCS publishing division.
Press reports said that the arrests were linked to the illegal export of funds from Gemina, but there was no confirmation of this from the police.
